title: Appeal 25062: alternative 3-hour fire protection of structural steel in concrete members (OSSC 104.11, UL Design X854)

facts.text: Appeal item quotes OSSC 104.11: alternative materials, designs and methods are approved where equivalent in quality, strength, effectiveness, fire resistance, durability and safety; subsections require research reports and may require tests.

The proposal is for reinforcing steel attached to large concrete members as C-channel or plate sections (C12 x 30, MC18 x 42.7, MC18 x 58, and a 3/16-inch by 11-inch plate), compared to UL Design X854 with an engineering judgment letter.
Decision: alternate 3-hour fire-rated C-channel and steel plate structural assemblies with engineering analysis is granted as proposed.
